description: This is a Python source file implementing an asynchronous function 'get_chart_data' for retrieving chart data in various formats (json, csv, excel) from a Superset-based system. It includes logic for chart lookup, query construction, data retrieval, caching, and exporting data, with support for fallback mechanisms and detailed metadata generation.
